notes: Mobile Chrome and iPhone runs are browser/device emulation, not physical phone tests.
Timings use the same-host localhost static server, with no network throttle; OS and file caches may be warm.
JS heap counters exclude native/WASM engine memory. Worker counts track actual constructed/terminated workers.

Optional Linux Chromium snapshots report aggregate renderer/worker RSS and full browser process RSS via CDP and /proc. Shared pages may be counted more than once. These are process observations, not isolated engine allocations; RSS need not immediately return after termination.
Tests build a separate fixture with production Vite chunking; the main production website is verified separately.
